passage.text: Hi, Nam! Merry Christmas from Toronto!
passage.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm! ˈmɛri ˈkrɪsməs frəm təˈrɑːntoʊ!

passage.text: It's freezing here, and the city is white with snow.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈfriːzɪŋ ˈhɪr, ənd ðə ˈsɪti ɪz ˈwaɪt wɪð ˈsnoʊ.

passage.text: Yesterday, all my relatives came to our house for Christmas dinner.
passage.reading: ˈjɛstərdeɪ, ˈɔːl maɪ ˈrɛlətɪvz ˈkeɪm tu aʊr ˈhaʊs fər ˈkrɪsməs ˈdɪnər.

passage.text: My dad cooked a big turkey, and my grandmother made three cakes.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈdæd ˈkʊkt ə ˈbɪɡ ˈtɜːrki, ənd maɪ ˈɡrænmʌðər ˈmeɪd ˈθriː ˈkeɪks.

passage.text: After dinner, we sat by the fireplace and opened our gifts.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ˈdɪnər, wiː ˈsæt baɪ ðə ˈfaɪərpleɪs ənd ˈoʊpənd aʊr ˈɡɪfts.

passage.text: My little cousins sang Christmas songs all evening.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈlɪtəl ˈkʌzənz ˈsæŋ ˈkrɪsməs ˌsɔːŋz ˈɔːl ˈiːvnɪŋ.

passage.text: I love Christmas at home, but I miss you and Thai food!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈlʌv ˈkrɪsməs ət ˈhoʊm, bʌt aɪ ˈmɪs juː ənd ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd!
